post.title: The 401(k) match is free acorns. Here's the math
post.ig:
Your boss might pay you 50% just for saving.

Most common formula: 50% of what you put in, up to 6% of pay (Vanguard).
On a $50,000 salary: save 6% ($3,000) and the match is $1,500. Save 3% and it's $750.
The 2026 employee limit is $24,500 (IRS); the match is on top. Some matches vest over time.

Sources: Vanguard How America Saves, IRS (Nov 2025).
News and education, not financial advice.
